Copied modules: server/lib/qq-client.ts, netease-client.ts, cookie.ts, http.ts;
electron/modules/login-manager.ts, safe-open.ts. Server modules and safe-open.ts are unmodified.
Flow Cabin modifies login-manager.ts: HTTPS provider navigation allowlist, expired-cookie filtering,
full playback-ticket requirement, and cancellation/generation guards for logout and overlapping login.
Album Circle's original music-service.cjs and room playback interface adapt these modules.
Build: npm ci in the main source and desktop; npm --prefix desktop run build:music.
The generated music-upstream.cjs and music-login.cjs remove diagnostic console calls.
Corresponding editable source, build scripts and lockfiles are included in the delivery source archive.
No audio or platform credentials are included in the source or deliverables.
